service.method: INSERT INTO SGWGL ( HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , APP_NO , APP_NO_SEQ , APP_TYPE , APP_SUBJECT , APP_CONTENTS , APP_STATUS , CURRENT_STAGE , CUST_GW_ID , CUST_GW_SUBJECT , DEL_FLAG , SUX_WKEY1 , SUX_WKEY2 , SUX_WKEY3 , SUX_WKEY4 , SUX_WKEY5 , SUX_WKEY6 , SUX_WKEY7 , SUX_WKEY8 , SUX_WKEY9 , SUX_WKEY10 , APP_USER_DATE , APP_USER_TIME , APP_USER_ID , APP_USER_AMT , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID ) VALUES ( ${session.HOUSE_CODE} , ${SEPOA_APPROVAL_S_COMPANY_CODE} , ${APP_NO} , ${APP_NO_SEQ} , ${APP_TYPE} , ${APP_SUBJECT} , ${APP_CONTENTS} , ${APP_STATUS} , '1' , ${CUST_GW_ID} , ${CUST_GW_SUBJECT} , 'N' , ${SUX_WKEY1} , ${SUX_WKEY2} , ${SUX_WKEY3} , ${SUX_WKEY4} , ${SUX_WKEY5} , ${SUX_WKEY6} , ${SUX_WKEY7} , ${SUX_WKEY8} , ${SUX_WKEY9} , ${SUX_WKEY10} , ${current.DATE} , ${current.TIME} , ${session.ID } , ${APP_USER_AMT } , ${current.DATE} , ${current.TIME} , ${session.ID} , ${current.DATE} , ${current.TIME} , ${session.ID} )

INSERT INTO SGWLN ( HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , APP_NO , APP_NO_SEQ , APP_LINE_SEQ , APP_STAGE , APP_TYPE , APP_METHOD , APP_LINE_STATUS , APP_USER_ID , ACCEPT_USER_ID , APP_DEVICE , ACCEPT_DATE , ACCEPT_TIME , ACCEPT_REASON , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID ) VALUES ( ${session.HOUSE_CODE} , ${SEPOA_APPROVAL_S_COMPANY_CODE} , ${APP_NO} , ${APP_NO_SEQ} , ${APP_LINE_SEQ} , ${APP_STAGE} , ${APP_TYPE} , ${APP_METHOD} , '' , ${APP_USER_ID} , '' , '' , '' , '' , ${ACCEPT_REASON} , ${current.DATE} , ${current.TIME} , ${session.ID} , ${current.DATE} , ${current.TIME} , ${session.ID} )

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , LINE_TYPE , APP_TYPE , CODE , APP_TYPE , LINE_SEQ , APP_USER_AMT , USER_ID AS APP_USER_ID , USE_FLAG FROM SGWAD WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${SEPOA_APPROVAL_S_COMPANY_CODE} AND LINE_TYPE = ${MANAGEMENT_LINE_TYPE} AND APP_TYPE = ${MANAGEMENT_APP_TYPE} AND CODE = ${MANAGEMENT_CODE} ORDER BY CAST(#DB_OWNER#NVL(LINE_SEQ,'999') AS INT)

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , LINE_TYPE , APP_TYPE , CODE , APP_TYPE , LINE_SEQ , APP_USER_AMT , USER_ID AS APP_USER_ID , 'Y' AS USE_FLAG FROM SGWAD WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${SEPOA_APPROVAL_S_COMPANY_CODE} AND LINE_TYPE = ${MANAGEMENT_LINE_TYPE} AND APP_TYPE = ${MANAGEMENT_APP_TYPE} AND CODE = ${MANAGEMENT_CODE} ORDER BY CONVERT(#DB_OWNER#NVL(LINE_SEQ,'999'), INT)

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , APP_NO , APP_NO_SEQ , APP_LINE_SEQ , APP_STAGE , APP_TYPE , APP_METHOD , APP_LINE_STATUS , APP_USER_ID FROM SGWLN WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${SEPOA_APPROVAL_S_COMPANY_CODE} AND APP_NO = ${APP_NO} AND APP_NO_SEQ = ${APP_NO_SEQ} AND APP_TYPE = '02' ORDER BY CONVERT(#DB_OWNER#NVL(APP_LINE_SEQ ,'999'), INT)
